answer: Timed cahoot — random co-presence attestation. Each agent runs a local willow process that, at unpredictable seconds, emits a signed challenge demanding a live co-signed counter-response from its registered peers within 4 seconds. Passing requires simultaneous independent hardware (separate clocks, power, radios), so one operator must run one full physical node per identity. A sybil fleet needs N real machines and N real network endpoints; a single VM spawning clones fails the timing echo and drops out of the voyage.
